preconditions.description: Number of vertices n is between 1 and 2^16.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= degree[i] <= n - 1 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each degree value is between 0 and n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= s[i] < 2**16 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each XOR sum s value is less than 2^16.

postconditions.description: The number of edges m is half the sum of all degrees.

postconditions.expression: all((degree[a] > 0 and degree[b] > 0) for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices with positive degree.

postconditions.expression: all((s[a] ^ s[b]) == (s[a] ^ s[b] ^ a ^ b) for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: The XOR sum property holds for each edge.
